content: शेष {%a.%} [शिष्-अच्] Remaining, rest, all the other; न्यषेधि शेषोऽप्यनुयायिवर्गः <ls>R. 2. 4</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 64</ls>, <ls n="R.">10. 29</ls>; <ls>Me. 30</ls>, <ls n="Me.">89</ls>; रम्भे निर्वर्त्यतां शेषो विधिः <ls>V. 5</ls>; शेषान् मासान् गमय चतुरो लोचने मीलयित्वा <ls>Me. 110</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>); <ls>Ms. 3. 47</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 44</ls>; <ab>oft.</ab> at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> in this sense; भक्षितशेष, आलेख्यशेष <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-षः, -षम्@} .²1 .³({%a%}) Remainder, rest, residue; ऋणशेषोऽग्निशेषश्च व्याधिशेषस्तथैव च . पुनश्च वर्धते यस्मात्तस्माच्छेषं न कारयेत् .. <ls>Chāṇ. 40</ls>; अध्वशेष <ls>Me. 40</ls>; प्रतिकारविधानमायुषः सति शेषे हि फलाय कल्पते <ls>R. 8. 40</ls>; so शेषे वयसः समागतो मृत्युः <ls>Bv. 4. 30</ls>; त्रिभागशेष <ls>Ku. 5. 57</ls>; वाक्यशेषः <ls>V. 3</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> .³({%b%}) Surplus, balance. .²2 Anything left out or omitted to be said; (इति शेषः is often used by commentators in supplying an ellipsis or words necessary to complete the construction). .²3 Escape, salvation, respite. .{@-षः@} .²1 Result, effect. .²2 End, termination, conclusion. .²3 Death, destruction. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated serpent, said to have one thousand heads, and represented as forming the couch of Viṣṇu or as supporting the entire world on his head; किं शेषस्य भरव्यथा न वपुषि क्ष्मां न क्षिपत्येष यत् <ls>Mu. 2. 18</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 13</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 13</ls>. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Balarāma (supposed to be an incarnation of Śeṣa). .²6 An elephant. .²7 Subsidiary अङ्ग; something which is declared as being subservient to something else; शेषः परार्थत्वात् <ls>MS. 3. 1. 2</ls> (यस्तु अत्यन्तं परार्थस्तं वयं शेष इति ब्रूमः <ls>ŚB. on MS.</ls>); शेषो हि सादनम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 5. 76</ls>. .²8 Favour (प्रसाद); ‘शेषः संकर्षणे वधे अनन्ते ना प्रसादे च’ इति मेदिनी; नैवंशीलाः शेषमिहाप्नुवन्ति <ls>Mb. 1. 197. 24</ls>. .{@-षा@} The remains of flowers or other offerings made to an idol and distributed among the worshippers as a holy relique; तस्यै स्त्रियस्ताः प्रददुः शेषां युयुजुराशिषः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 53. 50</ls>; तथेति शेषामिव भर्तुराज्ञामादाय मूर्ध्ना मदनः प्रतस्थे <ls>Ku. 3. 22</ls>; <ls>Ś. 3</ls>. .{@-षम्@} The remnants of food, remains of an offering. (शेषे is used adverbially in the sense of .²1 at last, finally. .²2 in other cases; as in शेषे षष्टी.)
